change_note: Per-device Modbus read block limits & V5 store migration: (1) parse optional connection.maxReadRegisters (1..125) and connection.maxRegisterGap (0..124) in NG_ReadDevice/NG_CheckConfig/NG_SameConfig; (2) enforce per-device EffectiveContigSpan and EffectiveMaxGap in NG_Modbus while clamping gap spans to EffectiveContigSpan; (3) freeze NG4_Device/NG4_File and upgrade NG_Store to FormatVersion 5 with lossless V4->V5 persistence migration.
